in_hebrew.name: Banquer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Banquer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'banquetes', meaning 'banquet'. In ancient Greece, a banquetes was the master of the feast who ensured guests were well-fed and entertained. This name carries the traits of a hospitable, generous, and joyful host.
